description: Synthetic-only scalar rest-to-rest third-order seven-segment jerk-limited S-curve reference profile. This fixture is for numerical/software verification, not a CNC axis setting or recommended motion parameter.

provenance.parameter_source: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE: all numerical values are authored solely for reproducible algorithm verification. SRC-000375 supports the distinction between third-order seven-segment bounded-but-discontinuous jerk and a fourth-order fifteen-segment jerk-continuous profile; SRC-000376 supports distinct axis-space and Cartesian geometric constraints; SRC-000377 and SRC-000378 document LinuxCNC-specific path-blending and look-ahead semantics. No source supplies the numerical values in this fixture.

interpretation: Scalar rest-to-rest profile only. The fixture is not a CNC multi-axis inverse-kinematics planner, look-ahead block-chain solver, corner blender, fourth-order jerk-continuous/snap-limited planner, servo simulation, or machine acceptance procedure. All inputs are synthetic.
